title: Metaplex metadata update authority
detects: The address able to change the token's name, symbol and metadata URI after launch.
knownFalseNegative: This is a WEAK signal and must not be scored as a major risk. Mutable metadata was observed on RAY, JUP and BONK, three well established tokens. Scoring it heavily manufactures false positives on the majority of a blue-chip set. It is carried as context, not as a Control penalty.
rationale: Included so the signal is visible and explicitly de-weighted, rather than quietly omitted. Documenting why something does NOT count is part of a published methodology.
